title: fix(app-shell): Studio's form view canvas honours layout horizontal and the other form view keys
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb1jwz5572SRdM7sFPV66BJ3)_

Fixes #29676

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Claim 6593560214, surface amendment 6593906746.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:Studio「界面」里打开表单视图时,画布(设计和运行两种模式)现在按视图的 `layout` 画字段:`horizontal` 时标签在输入框左侧同一行,`vertical` 或未设置时标签在上方,和以前一样。画布同时会用上视图的 `columns`、`defaultTab`、`tabPosition`(分页表单)、`allowSkip`、`showStepIndicator`(向导表单)。
- **为什么改**:画布拼表单时只拿了 `type`、`sections`、`fields`,其余键全部丢掉。作者在属性面板里选了 horizontal,画布毫无变化,而终端用户的表单页其实已经按 horizontal 画了,两边看到的不一样。
- **风险与回滚**:只改 Studio 画布的显示,不改保存内容,也不改终端用户的表单页。`layout` 走的是控制台表单宿主自己用的同一个映射(`resolveFormViewChrome`),所以两边读法一致。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`ViewPreview.tsx` 的 `buildFormPreviewSchema`;新测试 `ViewPreview.formLayout-29676.test.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证**:在可写包里存一个 `config.layout: 'horizontal'` 的表单视图并发布,打开 `/studio/包ID/interfaces?surface=view:视图名`:设计和运行两种模式下,"Project Name" 标签都在输入框左边同一行;手机宽度下仍是上下排列(断点设计如此)。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`buildFormPreviewSchema` (the form view canvas, shared by Studio Design and Run) forwards the form view keys `ObjectForm` reads.** It built the `object-form` schema from `type`, `sections` and `fields` only, so a view stored with `config.layout: 'horizontal'` drew every label above its control in Studio while the console's form page drew it beside.
- **`layout` is read through `resolveFormViewChrome`**, the mapping the console's form hosts (`RecordFormPage`, the New/Edit modal) already use, so the canvas and the runtime read the key one way. Only its `layout` is taken: the canvas draws no submit or cancel and seeds no create values.
- **`columns`, `defaultTab`, `tabPosition`, `allowSkip` and `showStepIndicator` are passed as authored**, as `RecordFormPage` passes them: `columns` to the field grid, `defaultTab` / `tabPosition` to the tabbed layout, `allowSkip` / `showStepIndicator` to the wizard. A tabbed view now opens on its authored tab in Studio.
- **`title` and `description` are deliberately not forwarded.** Measured in `@object-ui/plugin-form`: only `DrawerForm`, `ModalForm` and `MasterDetailForm` read `schema.title` / `schema.description`. The canvas folds `drawer` / `modal` to `simple` (`toInlineFormType`), and `simple`, `tabbed` and `wizard` read neither key, so forwarding them would be a pin on a value nothing draws. Drawing a form's heading and description on the canvas would need new canvas markup, so it is listed under Acceptance notes rather than done here.
- `buildFormPreviewSchema` is now a named export, so the test can pin it directly. No other module reads it. It adds one `react-refresh/only-export-components` warning of the same kind the file's existing `resolveObjectName` export carries.
- The renderer's horizontal branch (`components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx`, #26843) is unchanged; it was already correct.

## Why

Studio's form view inspector offers Layout, so an author could pick `horizontal`, publish it, and see nothing change on the canvas, even though end users got it (#29672 acceptance[1]). Declared and enforced at runtime, but misdrawn where it is authored.

## Tests

`ViewPreview.formLayout-29676.test.tsx` (new, real `ViewPreview`, `@object-ui/plugin-form` registered):

- `horizontal` draws the field item with the renderer's label-column grid (`sm:grid` plus the two-column template) in Run, in Design (`editing`), and on a `tabbed` view.
- CONTROL: `vertical` and no layout draw the stacked item, with no `sm:grid`.
- The built schema carries `layout` through the console hosts' mapping (`horizontal` kept, `vertical` kept, unset becomes the renderer default `vertical`), and carries `columns`, `defaultTab`, `tabPosition`, `allowSkip` and `showStepIndicator` as authored.
- CONTROL: unauthored keys stay unset, and the canvas still draws no submit or cancel (`mode: 'create'`).
- `defaultTab: 'details'` opens the Details tab on the drawn tabbed form (`aria-selected`).

## Acceptance notes

- **The canvas draws no form heading or description.** A form view's `title` / `description` show on the console's `/forms` page (its own heading and description) but not on the Studio canvas, whose inline layouts read neither key. Out of scope here (see What changes); noted, not filed.
- **Phone width:** below the `sm` breakpoint a horizontal form stacks by design, on the canvas and on the console's form page alike (measured at 390 px below).
- **No end-user host drops `layout`.** The console's `/forms/NAME` page draws horizontal beside (measured), and `RecordFormPage` and AppContent's New/Edit modal forward it through `resolveFormViewChrome` (pinned by the #26843 tests).

## Verification

<details><summary>Live, on the showcase (dev --fresh, Vite source console, scratch package over REST)</summary>

Three published form views on `showcase_project` (`layout: horizontal`, `vertical`, unset), each with one two-column section (Project Name, Status). Label and control positions from `getBoundingClientRect` at 1440 px, x,y in px:

| surface | view | before (c76cdebf) | after (623f76a6) |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| Studio Design | horizontal | label 274,282 · control 274,300 (stacked, no grid) | label 274,290 · control 450,276 (beside, grid) |
| Studio Run | horizontal | label 274,282 · control 274,300 (stacked) | label 274,290 · control 450,276 (beside) |
| Studio Design / Run | vertical, unset | label 274,282 · control 274,300 | unchanged |
| console `/forms/NAME` | horizontal | label 429,191 · control 605,177 (beside) | unchanged |
| console `/forms/NAME` | vertical, unset | label 429,177 · control 429,197 | unchanged |

The label's y sits inside the control's height because the grid aligns the label on the control's first text line (`items-baseline`). At 390 px the horizontal view stacks on both surfaces (Studio label 34,351 · control 34,369; console label 33,165 · control 33,185).

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (ablation-replace.mjs on 623f76a6, src-resolved; each restored blob == HEAD, git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

- A: `layout: resolveFormViewChrome(` replaced by `layout: undefined && resolveFormViewChrome(` gives 4 failed / 5 passed (the three horizontal renders and the layout schema pin).
- B: `defaultTab: body.defaultTab,` replaced by `defaultTab: undefined,` gives 2 failed / 7 passed (the schema pin and the drawn tab).
- C: `columns: body.columns,` replaced by `columns: undefined,` gives 1 failed / 8 passed.

</details>

<details><summary>Local runs</summary>

- New file: 9/9 tests passed (623f76a6).
- Neighbour sweep, every ui test file naming `ViewPreview` or `resolveFormViewChrome` (18 files, locked, 2 workers): 443 tests passed (17181560).
- `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell`: 65/65 (623f76a6).
- eslint on the touched files: 0 errors.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 35 commands; all 35 exit 0 (17181560), incl. `check-sdui-manifest` and its self-test, `check:type-check-debt` (locked), and `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (170 files passed, 2 skipped, at `--maxWorkers=2`). `--ran` reconciliation 35/35, 0 NOT-MEASURED.
- After merging `origin/main` again (0d3b9c05, 9 commits, none touching these files; rebuilt 118/118): the 18-file neighbour sweep, 443 tests passed, and the app-shell type-check, 65/65.

</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (eslint on the touched files, 0 errors; the repo-wide lint is CI's.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
